A few words about me

Eleni Fyta, psychologist – psychotherapist in Athens

Therapy rests on a relationship of trust and genuine communication — a space where you can speak without fear or judgement.

I am a psychologist with a private practice in Athens since 2022. Alongside it I work with specialist therapy centres, with experience supporting adults, children and adolescents.

I studied Psychology at the National and Kapodistrian University of Athens and Pharmacy at the University of Patras — two paths that bring scientific knowledge together with a human-centred view.

I am continuing my psychotherapy training at the Hellenic Society of Group Psychoanalytic Psychotherapy (E.E.Ps.Ps.O.) and have completed postgraduate training in Clinical Psychopathology, in the annual “Panagiotis Oulis” programme of the 1st Psychiatric Clinic of the University of Athens and the University Mental Health Research Institute.

I have worked at specialist therapy centres such as “Mind Set Go Therapy” and “The House”, and on the SOS helpline “Dipla sou” of the Hellenic Network of Women in Europe, supporting survivors of domestic violence. I have also volunteered with the Hellenic Red Cross and in support programmes for refugees and migrants.

Licensed psychologist, licence no. 243374

The approach · psychoanalytic & psychodynamic

From what repeats, to meaning

As on a kilim, where the shapes make sense only once you see the whole pattern, so it is in psychotherapy: pieces that seem scattered slowly begin to connect.

  1. I

    What you bring

    Therapy starts from what troubles you today: a symptom, a difficulty, a question that will not go away.

  2. II

    The patterns

    Through our conversations, thoughts, feelings and ways of relating that repeat themselves start to show.

  3. III

    The inner conflicts

    The psychoanalytic view focuses on understanding the inner conflicts that lie behind these patterns.

  4. IV

    Personal growth

    With understanding comes room for change — for freer ways of living and of relating to others.

Services

Psychotherapy for adults, adolescents and groups

In person at the offices in Kypseli and Gyzi, or online by video call.

Individual psychotherapy for adults

50 minutes · in person or online

Psychoanalytic and psychodynamic psychotherapy in regular weekly sessions. A steady time and place to talk freely about whatever concerns you — from anxiety, sadness or burnout to relationships, sexuality and identity. The aim is to understand together what lies behind the difficulty, so that real change becomes possible.

Individual sessions for adolescents

50 minutes

Adolescence is a time of great change: in the body, in relationships, in how one sees oneself. Sessions give the young person a space of their own, with respect and confidentiality, to talk about what is hard — anxiety, school, friends, family or questions of identity — and to understand it better.

Group psychoanalytic therapy

90 minutes

In a group, a few people meet regularly with the therapist. The way we relate to others becomes visible within the group itself — and there it can be understood. The group offers the experience of not being alone, and many perspectives on the same questions.

Sessions by video call

50 minutes · online

When distance, your schedule or other reasons make visiting the office hard, sessions take place by video call, with the same consistency and confidentiality. All you need is a quiet place where you feel comfortable talking. Sessions are held in Greek or in English.

Special session fee for students, unemployed people and people with disabilities.

Questions

Frequently asked questions

Something else on your mind? Call me — we can talk it through before the first session.

How do I book a session?

You can call 210 744 2999 or book online through doctoranytime, choosing an office (Kypseli or Gyzi) or a video call. Available times are shown there too.

How long is a session?

An individual session lasts 50 minutes. Group psychoanalytic therapy lasts 90 minutes. Sessions usually take place once a week, on the same day and at the same time.

What is psychoanalytic – psychodynamic psychotherapy?

It is a talking therapy that focuses on understanding inner conflicts and the patterns that repeat in our lives. It does not hand out ready-made advice; it helps you understand in depth what is happening to you, so that change can be meaningful.

Are sessions available online?

Yes. Sessions can take place by video call, with the same length and confidentiality. All you need is a quiet place and a stable connection.

Where are the offices?

I see clients at two offices in central Athens: on Kypseli Square in Kypseli, and on Ragkavi Street in Gyzi. Neither has parking.

Do you also work with adolescents?

Yes. I offer individual sessions for adolescents, respecting the young person’s confidentiality and their own pace.

Is there a reduced fee?

Yes, there is a special session fee for students, unemployed people and people with disabilities. Just ask when you book.

How do payment and cancellation work?

Payment is made at the office, by card or in cash. You can cancel an appointment up to 3 hours before.

In which languages are sessions held?

Sessions are held in Greek or in English.
